metadata.description: History: 7,254 battles from AD 1000 to today with a location and date in Wikidata (CC0), colored by continent. The time slider shows one quarter-century at a time, opening on 1800 to 1824 (the Napoleonic Wars and Latin American wars of independence); press Play to move through the centuries. Coverage reflects what Wikidata editors have recorded.
